broadening.interpretation: broadened finite-bath realization; not the fitted continuum

conventions.hybridization: Gamma(omega) = pi * sum_k V_k^2 * delta(omega - epsilon_k)
conventions.quadrature: Gauss-Chebyshev quadrature of the second kind
conventions.target_continuum: Gamma_target(omega) = gamma * sqrt(1 - (omega / bandwidth)^2) for |omega| <= bandwidth; 0 otherwise
